```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

# Uploading Data
## Data from https://digital.atlas.gov.au/datasets/digitalatlas::abs-estimated-resident-population-sa2-2001-to-2023/about
## converting population to a projection so the datasets can talk to each other
### landed on CRS 28355 using this website: https://epsg.org/search/by-name/sessionkey/gd8wvem06u/polygon/%7B%22type%22%3A%22polygon%22%2C%22coordinates%22%3A%5B%5B%5B140.84%2C-44.57%5D%2C%5B150.13%2C-44.57%5D%2C%5B150.13%2C-37.23%5D%2C%5B140.84%2C-37.23%5D%2C%5B140.84%2C-44.57%5D%5D%5D%7D/crs_sort_by/type/crs_sort_dir/desc#crs

```{r}
rawpop <- st_read("Population Info/ABS_ERP_2001_2023_SA2.shp")

pop <- st_transform(rawpop, crs = 28355)
```


# Goal: Determine populations within 50 and 100 km radius of my surveys (no human gravity yet)

```{r}
# rough bounding box around data
combined <- read_csv("combined.csv")
# Convert your data frame to sf points
pts <- st_as_sf(combined, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Bounding box polygon
range_poly <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(pts))

# Expand the box by X degrees (e.g., 1 degree)
bigger_box <- st_buffer(range_poly, dist = 1)

bigger_box <- st_transform(bigger_box, crs = 28355)

population_filtered <- st_filter(pop, bigger_box)
```

```{r}
# i don't think i need this
bbox_region <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 125, xmax = 155, ymin = -52, ymax = -30), 
                        crs = 4326) %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_transform(crs = 28355)

population_filtered <- st_filter(pop, bbox_region)
```

## making the actual radii around the survey points (using wrasseMonthly for time being but can be changed obv)
```{r}
#you might need to put in a reading the data line here depending on the workflow
#fishMaster <- read_csv("fishMaster.csv")

combinedYears <- combined |>
  filter(year >= 2013, year <= 2022)

# make sure survey points are sf object
fish_sf <- st_as_sf(combinedYears, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# transform to a projected CRS for accurate distance measurements in meters (using CRS 28355)
fish_sf <- st_transform(fish_sf, crs = 28355)

# create 50km and 100km buffers
#st_buffer makes circular buffers by default
buffers_50km <- st_buffer(fish_sf, dist = 50000)
buffers_100km <- st_buffer(fish_sf, dist = 100000)
```

## Finding Intersects

```{r}
#intersect_100km <- st_intersection(population_filtered, buffers_100km)
#intersect_50km <- intersect_100km |>
  #filter(as.numeric(st_distance(st_centroid(geometry), survey_point)) <= 50000)
```

```{r}
#simplifying buffers a bit to make calculations easier
buffers_100km <- st_simplify(buffers_100km, dTolerance = 100)
```


```{r}
intersect_50km <- map_dfr(1:nrow(buffers_50km), function(i) {
  cat("Processing buffer", i, "of", nrow(buffers_50km), "\n")
  st_intersection(population_filtered, buffers_50km[i,])
})
#intersect_50km creates a dataframe with one row for each intersection point. so if survey A intersects with 5 regions, intersect_50km will have 5 rows, each row corresponding to one region that intersects survey A's buffer. the geometry at the end represents the shape of the region that intersects with survey A's buffer.
```

## Calculating population  within 50 km 

```{r}
#renaming columns so i can actually match them to the year dates
intersect_50km <- intersect_50km |>
  rename(pop_2012 = erp_no_212,
         pop_2013 = erp_no_213,
         pop_2014 = erp_no_214,
         pop_2015 = erp_no_215,
         pop_2016 = erp_no_216,
         pop_2017 = erp_no_217,
         pop_2018 = erp_no_218,
         pop_2019 = erp_no_219,
         pop_2020 = erp_no_220,
         pop_2021 = erp_no_221,
         pop_2022 = erp_no_222)
```

```{r}
# 1. calculate original areas
population_filtered <- population_filtered |>
  mutate(orig_area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))

# 2. join orig_area onto intersect_50km using whatever ID column 
# uniquely identifies each population polygon
intersect_50km <- intersect_50km |>
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(population_filtered) |> 
      select(sa2_code_2, orig_area),
    by = "sa2_code_2"
  )
```

```{r}
# calculate areas outside rowwise (much faster)
intersect_50km <- intersect_50km |>
  mutate(
    intersect_area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))
  )

# then do the rowwise part only for the column selection (much less work)
population_50km <- intersect_50km |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    correct_pop = get(paste0("pop_", year)),
    pop_in_buffer = correct_pop * (intersect_area / orig_area)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
readablepop <- population_50km |>
  select(c(sa2_code_2, sa2_name_2, survey_id, XID, survey_date, orig_area, intersect_area, correct_pop, pop_in_buffer))
```


```{r}
rawpopulation <- readablepop |>
  group_by(survey_id) |>
  summarise(
    population = sum(pop_in_buffer, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
rawpopulation <- st_drop_geometry(rawpopulation)
```

```{r}
write.csv(rawpopulation, "rawpopulation.csv")
```
